main.remarks: Represents the signing-time metadata supplied by a signature processor for signed envelope creation.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Create an empty access-key signature info value.

property.name: Algorithm
property.summary: Signature algorithm to declare in the outer access-key envelope.

property.name: SignerKeyIDFormat
property.summary: Format discriminator for the signer key identifier.

property.name: SignerKeyID
property.summary: Signer key identifier bytes to embed in the outer access-key envelope.

property.name: SignatureLength
property.summary: Expected signature byte length used to size the final signed envelope.
